metadata.lesson: Source-only repair was reused across eight languages. A bright foreground-hand mask must exclude dim thumbnail-photo skin; a generic rectangle or connected skin patch leaves source letters or clips native letters. Phone UI text must remain below the source-style caption capsule. Inspect the first source capsule/letter by frame index, not only the intended source caption interval. Actual spoken copy and caption are one script; final timing comes from adjusted voice and actual encoded pixels. These are observations on this one source, not cross-source proof.
metadata.evidence_semantics: Embedded historical records are immutable observations. Their old path strings are origin labels, not live dependencies. Use only this manifest's files.
metadata.proof_boundary: Preserved text, feedback and actual observed image/audio evidence. Does not preserve every full-video frame or make unobserved claims pass.
